proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item_root family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord in types.ts has SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord only. No MagicItemRecord exists. The magic_item_root atom exists in the v4 taxonomy but there is no corresponding surface record shape, mechanics header, or payload family to author into.

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: stunned
proposed_widenings.justification: The thunderclap save gate inflicts the Stunned condition on failure. types.ts Condition = 'prone' only; 'stunned' is not representable.
proposed_widenings.evidence: must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: daily_at_dawn (dice recharge)
proposed_widenings.justification: The weapon regains 1d4+1 expended charges daily at dawn. No existing RestResetCadence variant covers a time-of-day (dawn) recharge with a dice roll quantity; the current set covers only short/long rest semantics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The weapon regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: attunement_condition / cross-item activation gate
proposed_widenings.justification: Giant's Bane features only activate while attuned to this weapon AND wearing either Belt of Giant Strength or Gauntlets of Ogre Power (also attuned). No mechanism exists for cross-item attunement prerequisites gating feature activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are attuned to the weapon and wearing either a Belt of Giant Strength or Gauntlets of Ogre Power to which you are also attuned

proposed_widenings.name: crit_window (roll-20 trigger on creature-type filter)
proposed_widenings.justification: Giants' Bane fires when the wielder rolls exactly 20 on the d20 for an attack roll against a Giant. This is distinct from on_hit_window (any hit) and requires a roll-value gate plus a creature-type filter neither of which is modeled.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll made with this weapon against a Giant, the creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or die.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_ability_score (runtime item effect)
proposed_widenings.justification: Might of Giants increases the Strength score granted by Belt of Giant Strength / Gauntlets of Ogre Power by 4, to a max of 30. This is a runtime ability-score modification that the v4 taxonomy explicitly marks as out-of-scope / deferred.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Strength score bestowed by your Belt of Giant Strength or Gauntlets of Ogre Power increases by 4, to a maximum of 30.

notes: The primary blocker is the total absence of a MagicItemRecord kind in UnitRecord. Even with that added, at least five further widenings are required: stunned condition, dawn-recharge cadence, cross-item attunement gating, nat-20 crit_window atom, and ability-score modification. The thrown-weapon-returns mechanic (weapon flies back after hit or miss) is also unrepresented but is secondary to the above. Encoding was refused entirely — no .dhall or .json produced.
